propositions: _build_jira_backend constructs AcliClient without validating that JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, and JIRA_API_TOKEN are present and non-empty, allowing silent build of backends that fail only at first API call

Cloud adapter lacks the construction-time credential guard present in DC adapter, creating a test-parity gap where unconfigured Cloud environments build live-looking backends with anonymous credentials
JIRA_USER must be validated as an email address (containing @ with non-empty local and domain parts) since Cloud authentication uses the Atlassian account email as Basic-auth username

_build_jira_backend must raise BackendEnvError before AcliClient construction if any required credential is missing, whitespace-only, or invalid, naming every missing variable and documenting the anonymous-access consequence
test_cloud_build_backend_with_missing_credentials_does_not_fail_loudly currently documents and pins the silent-build behavior and must be flipped to assert loud failure

test_the_cloud_factory_also_asserts_conformance uses invalid (non-email) JIRA_USER in its fixture, which must be updated to a valid email so the test exercises the conformance guard instead of the credential guard
